When I met Origami they were a young start-up with innovative technology, products and ideas, their excitement was infectious! They were ready to disrupt the energy sector and needed a completely new web presence.


(To accompany hero image)
There wasn't much in the pot for photography but I knew they needed a special image, one that demonstrated energy but took the concept to a new level, I found this in a photographer on Flickr who totok this amazing shot from a high peak in Japan late at night. I negotiated a fair exclusive rights fee and with a little tweaking to the colouring and atmosphere (show this) I felt the image now hit the mark!


and this would involve reworking some of the poor branding they had been supplied.


   Sadly the branding that Origami had been supplied was pretty poor, so I had to sensitively raise this issue along with other various political and heirachical issues that were getting in the way of us having an agile and productive working relationship. The CTO was a real legend who took great lengths to help us understand what they were doing and also worked hard to get the relations right, he really believed in us and saw the heart we had for the project.

The ways they would change the sector were inspiring, intriguing and captivating.

UI/UX/Brand/design highlights 1
I suggested to Origami that their icons should be redesigned to echo the  sector-leading, energy pioneering mindset they embodied.  I said, "your assets needed to be high quality, confident and bold, an appearance in keeping with your mindset". They agreed, so what you see here is the old and the new side by side.</p><p>The older icons I felt were too varient in visual appearance and therefore weaker in styling overall, along with the fact they felt a bit 'old-school'.

UI/UX/Brand/design highlights 2
I found this magical picture on someone’s Flickr page and negotiated to gain the rights to it as it felt spot on for the feel of this business - out of this world ideas to change this world.

Rebranded, new website, rebrand was poor, using assets, old school, tough presentations and we were bascially saying we want to do a good job but you have commissioned someone to produce terrible assets for you. COlour pallette was good, attention to detail poorlogo, icons, needed reworking and the whole identity and photography needed bring to life instead of the poor helf-measure they had been given. Inspiring image, got usage rights CTO amazing man, amazing ideas and technology, really enjoyed learning so much. Disrupting the energy sector, really inspiring and exciting, learn so much, problems at board level, communication and internal politics ultimately undermined the project. Main point was a very tech led company without much experience, funded start-up, very rigid ideas, wrestled with them over and over again. Too logic focussed and driven, not empathetic, very hard to get board to agree together - too many chefs - democracy undermined itself here.
